summary: Erik Underwood's campaign site pledges to 'condemn the atrocities happening in Gaza' as governor and to support sponsoring Palestinian families 'fleeing the ongoing genocide in Gaza.' He also demands AIPAC register as a foreign agent under FARA, calling it a foreign government influence. Together these positions mark explicit opposition to the genocide and to the lobbying organization that pressures US policymakers on Israel.
